posts.title: Protolanguage
posts.summary: A track inspired by AWARÉ’s hypnotic live performances.
paragraphs: I came across a performance by AWARÉ on YouTube, hours long with a hypnotic trance spread across the audience. I was inspired by the few instruments they used and how they adapted the music over time. I wanted to implement some of this into my own style of writing, testing out the new sE2200 mic by sE Electronics while I was at it.

posts.title: Dotted Pyjama
posts.summary: Slappy, distorted beats and a fat spread bass over cinematic textures.
paragraphs: On a Black Friday spree, I convinced myself I needed another sample library by Spitfire (Albion Solstice) and some new saturation plugins. So, this track combines slappy, distorted beats and a fat spread bass over some cinematic textures.

posts.title: Tumbling Hedgehog
posts.summary: A comical Eurorack pattern from the Basimilus Iteritas Alter and Qu-Bit Data Bender.
paragraphs: As I was noodling around on my Eurorack trying out the Qu-Bit Data Bender fed from a Basimilus Iteritas Alter module by Noise Engineering, I stumbled upon this strange comical pattern. The track is pretty true to how I captured it, with some minor EQ tweaks and limiting. I like the acoustic textures in this, definitely a strange composition. Have a listen, if you will.
